scenes.basis: 19:1 "Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus, and found certain disciples"
19:8 "He entered into the synagogue, and spoke boldly for a period of three months"; 19:9 "he departed from them, and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus"

19:22 "Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while" - Paul is at Ephesus (19:1); the plan to see Rome (19:21) is a plan, never a setting

19:24 "a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen" - Demetrius's gathering names no place; the stir is at Ephesus (19:17 "who lived at Ephesus")
19:29 "The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater"; 19:31 "begged him not to venture into the theater"
